name: PocketMine-MP
author: admin@scon.host
description: PocketMine-MP Bedrock server egg with PM4, PM5 and PM6. PM4, PM5 and PM6 use QXRND distributions compatible with Bedrock 1.26.44. Support: https://discord.gg/qhUXn72rGB

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e
apt-get update
apt-get install -y curl jq file tar unzip zip
mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server
# Remove only runtime artifacts from previous installations; preserve worlds, plugins and configuration.
rm -rf bin PocketMine-MP.phar
ARCH=$([[ "$(uname -m)" == "x86_64" ]] && printf "amd64" || printf "arm64")
VERSION="${VERSION:-PM5}"
VERSION="${VERSION^^}"

if [[ "${VERSION}" == "PM4" ]]; then
  API_CHANNEL="4"
  PHP_VARIANT="PM4"
  API_URL="https://update.pmmp.io/api?channel=4"
  PHP_URL="https://github.com/QXRND/PHP-Binaries/releases/download/php-8.1-latest/php81pm4.tar.gz"
  DOWNLOAD_REPO="QXRND/PocketMine-MP-PM4"
  DOWNLOAD_ASSET="PocketMine-MP.phar"
elif [[ "${VERSION}" == "PM5" ]]; then
  API_CHANNEL="stable"
  PHP_VARIANT="PM5"
  API_URL="https://update.pmmp.io/api?channel=stable"
  PHP_URL="https://github.com/QXRND/PHP-Binaries/releases/download/php-8.2-latest/php82pm5.tar.gz"
  DOWNLOAD_REPO="QXRND/PocketMine-MP-PM5"
  DOWNLOAD_ASSET="PocketMine-MP.phar"
elif [[ "${VERSION}" == "PM6" ]]; then
  # PM6 uses the PHP 8.3 binary artifact published by the PM5 build channel.
  PHP_VARIANT="PM5"
  PHP_URL="https://github.com/QXRND/PHP-Binaries/releases/download/php-8.3-latest/php83pm5.tar.gz"
  DOWNLOAD_REPO="QXRND/PMMP6-CLOSED"
  DOWNLOAD_ASSET="PocketMine-MP.phar"
else
  echo "Unsupported version: ${VERSION}. Use PM4, PM5 or PM6."
  exit 1
fi

if [[ "${VERSION}" == "PM6" ]]; then
  REQUIRED_PHP_VERSION="8.3"
  DOWNLOAD_LINK="https://github.com/${DOWNLOAD_REPO}/releases/download/qxrnd-26.44/${DOWNLOAD_ASSET}"
else
  REQUIRED_PHP_VERSION=$(curl -fsSL "${API_URL}" | jq -r '.php_version')
  DOWNLOAD_LINK=$(curl -fsSL "https://api.github.com/repos/${DOWNLOAD_REPO}/releases/latest" | jq -r --arg asset "${DOWNLOAD_ASSET}" '.assets[] | select(.name == $asset) | .browser_download_url')
  if [[ -z "${DOWNLOAD_LINK}" || "${DOWNLOAD_LINK}" == "null" ]]; then
    echo "No usable latest release asset found in ${DOWNLOAD_REPO}"
    exit 1
  fi
fi

if [[ "${ARCH}" != "amd64" ]]; then
  echo "This egg currently supports x86_64/amd64 PHP binaries only."
  exit 1
fi

if [[ -z "${PHP_URL:-}" ]]; then
  PHP_URL="https://github.com/pmmp/PHP-Binaries/releases/download/php-${REQUIRED_PHP_VERSION}-latest/PHP-Linux-x86_64-${PHP_VARIANT}.tar.gz"
fi
echo "Downloading PHP ${REQUIRED_PHP_VERSION} (${PHP_VARIANT})"
curl --fail --location --retry 3 --progress-bar "${PHP_URL}" | tar -xzv
# The upstream binary php.ini may contain a GitHub Actions runner path for opcache.
if [[ -f bin/php7/bin/php.ini ]]; then
  sed -i -E 's|^[[:space:]]*zend_extension[[:space:]]*=.*opcache\.so.*$|; zend_extension=opcache.so|' bin/php7/bin/php.ini
fi

echo "Downloading ${VERSION} from ${DOWNLOAD_LINK}"
curl --fail --location --retry 3 --progress-bar "${DOWNLOAD_LINK}" --output PocketMine-MP.phar
if [[ ! -s PocketMine-MP.phar ]]; then
  echo "Downloaded PHAR is empty"
  exit 1
fi

if [[ ! -f server.properties ]]; then
  curl --fail --location --progress-bar --remote-name https://raw.githubusercontent.com/parkervcp/eggs/master/game_eggs/minecraft/bedrock/pocketmine_mp/server.properties
fi
touch banned-ips.txt banned-players.txt ops.txt white-list.txt server.log
mkdir -p players worlds plugins resource_packs
echo "${VERSION} installation complete. Support: admin@scon.host | Discord: https://discord.gg/qhUXn72rGB"

variables.name: Version to install
variables.description: Select PM4, PM5 or PM6. PM4 installs QXRND PM4 for Bedrock 1.26.44, PM5 installs QXRND PM5 for Bedrock 1.26.44, and PM6 installs the custom QXRND PM6 build for Bedrock 1.26.44.
